plain.description: Simple direct English with minimal jargon.

slang.description: Colloquial/slang forms whose pragmatic meaning depends strongly on context.

internet.description: Online/text-native English: abbreviations, meme-adjacent shorthand, compressed punctuation/forms.

caveman.description: User-facing label for intentionally minimal telegraphic English: dropped articles/auxiliaries, short content-word order. It is a rendering style, not an identity, ethnicity, intelligence claim, or historical-linguistic category.

technical.description: Explicit protocol/machine-adjacent English intended to minimize ambiguity.
